static_traits.name: Zhang Kaiwen
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to communicate with, but is relatively reserved when socializing with newly met people due to worry about others' judgment
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no history of psychological counseling or psychiatric treatment
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, clear expression, willing to cooperate; can specifically describe worries and experiences

basic_info.main_problem: I feel the need to hide my hobby of playing video games, worrying others will think me childish if they find out; this makes me feel ashamed and Anxious.
basic_info.core_demands: I noticed that this fear of being judged affects my self-expression and brings pain, so I hope to obtain counseling support and be myself more comfortably.
growth_experiences: A few years ago, a friend made negative comments about 'adults playing video games', deeming it immature. Since then, Zhang Kaiwen has been especially sensitive about mentioning hobbies in Social situations, tending to hide and downplay his gaming interest, fearing similar judgment again. This event has continued to affect his self-expression in long-term social interactions, reinforcing vigilance toward external evaluation and shame.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being taken seriously
People will think I am childish

special_situations.event: When discussing hobbies with newly met people or being asked about interests in social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I openly play video games at this age, I will be seen as childish and not taken seriously
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking about, hides, or downplays hobbies, reducing related social contact
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will laugh at me, think I am immature, and not take me seriously

special_situations.event: Recalls a friend's negative comments years ago about adults playing video games
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One negative comment represents most people's views, and similar judgments will keep occurring
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using that comment as justification, Self-protecting and long-term avoiding disclosing the hobby
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone thinks adults who play games are childish

special_situations.event: Before preparing to disclose his gaming hobby to a relatively open-minded friend
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As soon as I say it, I will be laughed at or accused of being 'too old to play games'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitating indecisively, seeking 'safe targets', making disclosure plans to reduce risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time I will also be laughed at or not taken seriously

special_situations.event: Sees or thinks of society's stereotypes about age and activities (such as others' talk or media views)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One must conform to age norms, otherwise be negated and looked down on
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Measures herself by others' approval as the standard, reducing exposure to avoid evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Playing games at this age is inappropriate and will be looked down on

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and taken seriously, able to express oneself Freely and authentically
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as childish, being laughed at and negated, triggering shame and Anxiety
defense_goal: Avoids others' judgment by hiding and downplaying hobbies, maintaining self-esteem and a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A self who is easily judged and needs to hide true interests
object_relations.object_representation: Others with judging and negating tendencies (harsh bystanders)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the topic of 'personal hobbies' comes up in social situations or with newly acquainted people
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will think me immature and laugh at me like that friend did (treating an individual evaluation as a universal attitude)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding deep emotional expression, answering briefly or Displacing topics to neutral content, calm tone but keeping distance.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the causes of problems or trying to explain why one hides hobbies
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Uses 'social stereotypes' as the main cause, downplaying the complexity of personal feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using generalized, abstract language to Interpret phenomena, reducing emotional words, emphasizing 'social factors', with an objective, restrained tone.

manifestations: Repressing self-expression for fear of others' judgment, hiding and downplaying the video game hobby
outcomes: Not daring to present the true self in social situations

manifestations: Not discussing this issue with friends, struggling to open up to newly acquainted people

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Avoiding or Displacing topics when talking about hobbies
Avoiding attending social events where the hobby might come up

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Presumes others will mock or belittle oneself ('they will laugh at me')
Treating an individual negative comment as a universal attitude

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the energy originally to be emitted outward by instinct, turning it toward oneself instead, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Pushes the urge to share interests back into oneself, choosing to hide and downplay
Self-blocking disclosure when expression is possible

positive_force: Has some social support (friends to communicate with)
Actively seeks counseling help; willing to change
Having self-awareness of the problem, able to describe trigger situations and impacts
Work performance not yet affected, with life stability
negative_force: Fearing others' judgment, overly caring about outside opinions
Mind reading and catastrophically predicting others' reactions (jumping to conclusions: others will laugh)
Tendency to downplay and hide the hobby leading to Social avoidance
Overgeneralizing an individual negative comment into universal prejudice

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids talking about or disclosing one's video game hobby in social situations
antecedent: Discussing hobbies with newly met people
Being asked about interests or lifestyle in social settings
Recalls past friends' negative comments about adults playing games
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged as childish and not taken seriously; an avoidance strategy formed under the influence of the negative comment from years ago and social age stereotypes
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and shame, maintaining safety and self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Restricted self-expression, difficulty building deeper connections with new friends, intensified Anxiety and shame, Sleep affected
